source: the norms of docs/research/FRONTS_RESEARCH_2026-11.md section 2 (fm_101_10_1_1976, hero_1972_oralfore, ciano_1988_qjm, fm_100_2_1_1984, mt_perventsev_balance) and SAM3D game values where no source gives a number, each labelled
notes: A gameplay-level model with period norms, not a simulation of fire (docs/fronts/README.md decision 4). Strength is weighted equipment plus personnel; power is strength times posture, supply and cohesion; the ratio sets each side's daily loss and the attacker's advance. Percentages are as the manuals print them; the loader turns them into fractions.

strength.unit: T-55 equivalents: a T-55 is 1 (SAM3D's unit of weighted strength)

weights.source: estimate (SAM3D): the unit of strength; weights by mt_perventsev_balance's method (one coefficient per type of weapon from its effect in a meeting engagement), recomputed for 1985's types by judgement, not their 1968 numbers

supply_floor.source: game value: a unit wholly out of supply fights at half its power; power scales linearly from there to 1 at full supply

cohesion_floor.source: game value: a unit whose cohesion is gone still fights at three tenths of its power until it breaks

attack.source: ciano_1988_qjm fig. 24 (Dupuy's QJM posture factors, NPW 1985 p. 48)

ground.source: game value: the reference ground (HERO's rates are normalised to it, hero_1972_oralfore p. IV-2)
game value: woods help the defender and slow the advance (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 4)
game value: the border ranges and their gorges (docs/COUNTRY_MAP.md)

night_attacker.source: game value: night multiplies the attacker's power (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 4)

poor_visibility_attacker.source: game value: fog, rain or snow multiply the attacker's power

river_line_defender.source: game value: a river line multiplies the defender's power until the attacker has crossed

losses.notes: Daily losses of a division in contact, % of its strength, by action: battle on the first day and on later days, and nonbattle (FM 101-10-1 table 5-8, page image checked in docs/research/fronts_2026-11/nato_ground.md loss-01). The manual says they rest on WWII and Korea and hold for up to 5 days.

reference_ratio.source: game value at the ratio the manual's planning tables assume (fm_101_10_1_1976 p. 7-16: a threat to friendly force ratio of three or four to one); the table's rates hold at it

ratio_exponent.source: game value: away from the reference ratio each side's battle losses scale by (3/R)^k for the attacker and (R/3)^k for the defender (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 4)

tank_losses.notes: Tank losses of an armoured or mechanised division, % of its operational tanks, by day of its commitment; days 2 and 3 of the tanks on hand at the start of day 1. Assumes a threat to friendly ratio of three or four to one.

advance.notes: HERO's normalised WWII rates by opposition (hero_1972_oralfore p. IV-2, page image checked: moderate is 10.10, not the OCR's 19.10). Which ratio makes which opposition is SAM3D's mapping (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 4); below the first threshold there is no sustained advance, HERO's conclusion.

intact_bridge_h.source: game value: hours to take and cross an intact bridge under fire

cut_bridge_h.source: game value: hours to cross where the bridge is cut (assault boats, fords, the engineers' means)

pontoon_factor.source: game value: an engineers' pontoon park on hand halves the time where the bridge is cut

trait_shift.source: game value: a commander's traits move a threshold by at most this share of its range, as track B's officers do (docs/air_battle/README.md decision 9; docs/fronts/README.md decision 6)

loss_per_strength_loss.source: game value: cohesion falls twice as fast as strength within a day's fighting (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 3.1)

air_attack_loss.source: game value: cohesion one air attack on the unit costs it

recovery_per_day.source: game value: cohesion regained a day out of contact

break_below.source: game value: a unit whose cohesion falls below this breaks and disperses (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 5.4)

reassemble_min_days.source: game value: a dispersed unit's remnants reassemble behind in 1-3 days (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 5.4)

straggler_loss.source: game value: the share of a dispersed unit's remaining strength lost as stragglers

road_day_kmh.source: fm_100_2_1_1984 p. 5-2 (mixed columns by day on roads)

halt_h.source: fm_100_2_1_1984 p. 5-4: short halts of 20-30 minutes

division_per_day.source: game value: a division's combat report twice a day and at once on a breakthrough, a withdrawal or a commander lost (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 10)

down_after_h.source: game value: a formation goes down a level 6 h after it is out of need (docs/fronts/03_GROUND_WAR.md section 3.3, track B's margins)
